blocking.heading: When you write a sentence
blocking.text: Put it next to the step that the problem makes incorrect.
blocking.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/agent-skills-spec.md line 65 ("When you write the body"), "it" can refer to "each known problem", to "the section", or to "the condition" of the sentence before it.
blocking.correction: "Put the known problem next to the step that the problem makes incorrect."

advisory.heading: When you select a technical noun
